scripts.name: Get-Version
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc --version

scripts.name: Probe-LxcDaemon
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxd --version

scripts.name: Get-Container
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc list --format json

scripts.name: Create-Container
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc init {image} {name}

scripts.name: Launch-Container
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc launch {image} {name}

scripts.name: Start-Container
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc start {name}

scripts.name: Stop-Container
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc stop {name}

scripts.name: Restart-Container
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc restart {name}

scripts.name: Remove-Container
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc delete {name}

scripts.name: Rename-Container
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc rename {name} {newName}

scripts.name: Get-ContainerInfo
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc info {name} --format json

scripts.name: Get-ContainerLogs
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc info {name} --show-log

scripts.name: Exec-Container
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc exec {name} -- {command}

scripts.name: List-ContainerFiles
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc file list {name}/{path}

scripts.name: Read-ContainerFile
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc file pull {name}/{path} -

scripts.name: Write-ContainerFile
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC printf '%s' '{content}' | base64 -d | wsl -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc file push - {name}/{path}

scripts.name: Write-ContainerFile-Temp
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc file push {tempFilePath} {name}/{path}

scripts.name: Delete-ContainerFile
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc file delete {name}/{path}

scripts.name: Export-ContainerFile
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc file pull {name}/{path} - | base64 -w0

scripts.name: Get-ContainerSnapshots
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc info {name} --format json

scripts.name: Create-Snapshot
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc snapshot {name} {snapshot}

scripts.name: Restore-Snapshot
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc restore {name} {snapshot}

scripts.name: Delete-Snapshot
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc delete {name}/{snapshot}

scripts.name: Add-PortProxy
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc config device add {name} proxy-{hostPort} proxy listen=tcp:0.0.0.0:{hostPort} connect=tcp:127.0.0.1:{containerPort}

scripts.name: Remove-PortProxy
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc config device remove {name} {deviceName}

scripts.name: List-PortProxies
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc config show {name} --format json

scripts.name: Set-ResourceLimit
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc config set {name} {key}={value}

scripts.name: List-LxcImages
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc image list images: --format json 2>/dev/null || echo '[]'

scripts.name: Pull-LxcImage
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc image copy {remote}:{image} local: --alias {alias}

scripts.name: List-Profiles
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc profile list --format json

scripts.name: Restore-AutoStartContainers
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc list --format json | wsl -u root -d Ubuntu-LXC lxc start
